description: This source file defines an ApiClient class for managing network requests using the Dio package in Dart/Flutter. It includes features such as base URL configuration, JWT token management, request retries, circuit breaker, and mock mode handling. The class provides a generic request method with automatic token refresh and error handling, along with interceptors for authentication.
